admission.justification: The renderer and ordinary publication owner are separate files, and binding them prevents a successfully edited child dependency from leaving authoritative master Markdown stale or requiring an untracked side write.

applicability: Ordinary document publication of a master’s rendered Markdown and the affected parent rendering after a child dependency edit.
conditions: The current Order is derived and supplied to the renderer through native publication.
An explicit waitsFor edit publishes the edited document and affected master Markdown through the existing batch path.
exclusions: Post-publication side writes to repair the master rendering.

evidence: Parent examination of actual F01 changed extents; no new execution or acceptance.

statement: A master’s rendered Markdown includes its current derived Order through ordinary document publication, without storing waves or post-publication side writes.
